scene: seated on a street bench eating a pastry, catching crumbs

intro.ko: 초콜릿색 울 코트와 코듀로이 사이로 크림색 케이블 니트가 보인다. 벤치에 앉을 때 코트 앞을 열어 니트와 목도리를 드러냈다.
intro.en: A cream cable knit shows between dark chocolate wool and corduroy. Open the coat as you sit to let the knit and the scarf show.
intro.de: Zwischen schokobrauner Wolle und Cord kommt ein cremefarbener Zopfstrickpullover zum Vorschein. Beim Sitzen zeigt der offene Mantel Strick und Schal.

deck.ko: 벤치에서 갓 산 빵을 먹다 부스러기를 받아 내는 따뜻한 갈색 차림.
deck.en: Warm browns for a bench break, catching pastry crumbs in the winter sun.
deck.de: Warme Brauntöne für eine Pause auf der Bank, samt Gebäckkrümeln in der Wintersonne.

tip.ko: 갈색을 위아래로 이어 입을 땐 크림 니트와 오트밀 목도리처럼 밝은 색을 가운데 두면 무거워 보이지 않아요.
tip.en: When you wear brown head to toe, keep the light colours in the middle, like the cream knit and oatmeal scarf, so it never looks heavy.
tip.de: Wer Braun von Kopf bis Fuß trägt, setzt helle Töne wie Cremestrick und Haferschal in die Mitte – so wirkt es nie schwer.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery)

howToWear.ko: 벤치에 앉을 때 앞을 열어 코트가 양옆으로 떨어지게 한다.
howToWear.en: Open the coat as you sit so it falls at either side.
howToWear.de: Beim Hinsetzen den Mantel öffnen, damit er seitlich herabfällt.

howToWear.ko: 목도리를 느슨하게 둘러 케이블 짜임이 보이게 한다.
howToWear.en: Keep the scarf loose enough to show the cable pattern.
howToWear.de: Den Schal locker binden, damit das Zopfmuster sichtbar bleibt.

howToWear.ko: 코듀로이의 골이 눌리지 않도록 무릎이 편한 여유를 둔다.
howToWear.en: Leave room at the knee so the corduroy drapes comfortably when seated.
howToWear.de: Am Knie genug Platz lassen, damit die Cordhose beim Sitzen locker fällt.

products.spec: dark brown suede lug ankle boots

howToWear.ko: 스웨이드 부츠에는 밝은 울 양말을 살짝 보이게 신는다.
howToWear.en: Let a little of the light wool sock show above the suede boots.
howToWear.de: Über den Wildlederstiefeln etwas von den hellen Wollsocken zeigen.

howToWear.ko: 갈색 비니를 코트와 비슷한 톤으로 맞춘다.
howToWear.en: Pick up the coat’s warm brown with the knit beanie.
howToWear.de: Den warmen Braunton des Mantels mit der Strickmütze aufgreifen.

howToWear.ko: 프린지 한쪽을 앞으로 내려 코트의 어두운 색을 밝힌다.
howToWear.en: Let one fringed end fall forward against the dark coat.
howToWear.de: Ein Fransenende als hellen Akzent vor dem dunklen Mantel hängen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 벤치에 앉아 햇볕을 즐길 때 착용한다.
howToWear.en: Wear them while sitting in the direct sun.
howToWear.de: Beim Sitzen in der direkten Sonne aufsetzen.

howToWear.ko: 코듀로이 밑단과 부츠 사이에 밝은 양말을 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Show a band of light wool between the corduroy and the boots.
howToWear.de: Zwischen Cordhose und Stiefeln einen Streifen helle Wolle zeigen.
